item.title: ‘People will die…’: Elon Musk slams Zohran Mamdani’s appointment of first openly gay FDNY commissioner
item.description: Elon Musk criticized Zohran Mamdani's appointment of Lillian Bonsignore as FDNY commissioner, warning of potential public safety risks. Musk argued that proven firefighting experience is crucial for leadership, while supporters highlight Bonsignore's extensive EMS background and managerial expertise. The debate centers on whether direct firefighting experience or broader emergency management is more vital for the role.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Nina Lin unbanned again as Twitch faces backlash over repeated bans, shoplifting claims
item.description: Twitch restored Nina Lin’s account on December 25, 2025, after a ban linked to alleged shoplifting on stream. The move sparked heavy backlash online, with users questioning Twitch’s fairness and leadership. Nina Lin mocked the reaction on Instagram, while critics accused the platform of giving repeated second chances without clear explanations.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: PlaqueBoyMax speaks out about leaving FaZe Clan and Lacy getting kicked
item.description: FaZe Clan streamer PlaqueBoyMax has revealed details about Lacy's temporary removal and his own departure, citing a lack of creator control. He described feeling like a "puppet" due to creative limitations and legal bindings. These insights highlight the ongoing debate about autonomy within major esports organizations, with other members remaining silent.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Another baby in the West Wing? Karoline Leavitt is expecting a baby girl
item.description: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt and her husband Nick are expecting their second child, a baby girl, in May 2026. Their first son, Niko, was born in July 2024. Leavitt expressed gratitude for the pro-family environment in the White House and her excitement to become a "girl mom."
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: California’s tech exodus: Entrepreneur warns of a deeper political crisis as tax losses ‘hit $200 billion’
item.description: Tech mogul Chamath Palihapitiya warns California faces a deepening crisis as major companies depart, costing billions in lost tax revenue. He blames a hostile political climate towards innovation, citing Elon Musk's move to Texas. Palihapitiya argues this exodus weakens the state's job market and tax base, urging reforms to avoid severe financial stress.

item.title: Why do FaZe Clan members exit? Adin Ross explains ownership fight and rejected 20 percent contracts
item.description: GameSquare is now the sole owner of FaZe Clan after Richard Bengtsone exited in 2025. Several creators left the group on Christmas eve. Adin Ross claimed the exits happened after GameSquare asked creators to give up 20% stakes late. FaZe Banks denied any role and said he has moved on.

item.title: Mizkif net worth in 2025: Streaming revenue, career changes & earnings explained
item.description: Popular streamer Mizkif's net worth in 2025 is estimated between $4 million and $6.5 million, reflecting his diverse income streams. Despite career shifts, including a move to Kick, his earnings from subscriptions, ads, donations, sponsorships, and merchandise remain strong. This financial success highlights his adaptability in the challenging creator landscape.

item.title: 'When government does medical ...': Elon Musk slams Canadian hospital over death of Indian-origin man allegedly due to neglection
item.description: Elon Musk criticized Canadian healthcare after an Indian-origin man, Prashant Sreekumar, died at Grey Nuns Hospital. His wife reported he waited hours with severe chest pain, receiving only Tylenol, before collapsing. Hospital staff allegedly dismissed his symptoms as non-acute, leading to his death.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Meet Mora Namdar: Trump appoints beauty salon owner to oversee US passport and visa approvals
item.description: Mora Namdar, a Texas-based beauty salon owner and former government official, has been appointed Assistant Secretary of State for Consular Affairs. This influential role grants her significant control over US passport issuance and visa approvals. Namdar previously served in a similar capacity and has ties to Project 2025, a conservative policy initiative.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Candace Owens love rumors over Charlie Kirk resurface as TikTok fuels jealousy talk around Erika Kirk
item.description: A viral TikTok claims Candace Owens once loved Charlie Kirk and stayed bitter after he married Erika Kirk. Many users agree, calling it jealousy. Others checked dates and pushed back. Owens married George Farmer in 2019, while Kirk married Erika in 2021. The timeline weakens the rumor, but online debate continues.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Did Coca-Cola really invent Santa’s red suit? The surprisingly old story behind the myth
item.description: The idea that Coca-Cola invented Santa’s red suit persists every Christmas, but history tells a different story. Long before 20th-century advertising, writers and artists across Europe and America had already shaped Santa as a rotund, red-clad figure. Coca-Cola didn’t create the image; it amplified and standardised an existing tradition.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: The Indian-origin doctor whose plans to save lives were undone by Trump’s gutting of USAID
item.description: USAID's mission to make survival routine faced a devastating setback when its global health programs were dismantled. Surgeon Atul Gawande, who championed systems over heroics, witnessed the erosion of vital health infrastructure. This deliberate dismantling, driven by political choice, highlights how progress, built on consistent, unglamorous work, is tragically fragile and easily mistaken for waste.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Eating rice with hands, go back to home': Times when Nick Fuentes used anti-India slurs
item.description: White nationalist Nicholas Fuentes has repeatedly targeted India and its diaspora with racist and xenophobic remarks. He disparaged traditional Indian meals, mocked multicultural family gatherings, and questioned the Americanness of individuals with Indian heritage, including prominent figures like JD Vance's wife and Vivek Ramaswamy. Fuentes's rhetoric promotes an exclusionary vision of America.

item.title: Who is Matt Kalish and why Adin Ross is calling him out amidst FaZe Clan fallout
item.description: Matt Kalish, DraftKings co-founder and major FaZe Media stakeholder, is facing scrutiny after Adin Ross called out leadership decisions tied to recent FaZe Clan departures. Ross claims creators were asked for revenue cuts long after joining, sparking exits and controversy. Kalish, who owns nearly half of FaZe Media, has not publicly responded.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Shane Gillis floats Nick Fuentes as possible ‘next Catholic president’ on Joe Rogan podcast: 'Wild' but 'funny'
item.description: Comedian Shane Gillis and host Joe Rogan discussed far-right figure Nick Fuentes on The Joe Rogan Experience. Rogan speculated Fuentes could become the next Catholic president, citing his popularity among unrepresented young men and high verbal IQ. Gillis praised Fuentes' humor, even as Rogan acknowledged his extremist views and controversial statements, including a recent exchange with Piers Morgan.
